ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 75% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 25% concentrated on distal tips and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) polygon on the upper-outer right lobe. Serrated high-intensity (white) band along the distal upper-left lobe. Punctate white distributions scattered across the medial dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 80 degrees and a depth approximately 1/5th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations (peaks of 3-10 pixels) across both lobes; a prominent macro-indentation (missing tissue) on the upper-left distal margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve terminating in slightly convex outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of four distinct circular high-contrast ring-shaped scars on the medial-right lobe. Smaller cluster of three circular rings on the medial-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal white linear streaks localized in the lower medial dark regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular 'rosette' scars on both lobes; significant irregular indentation/trauma mark on the distal upper-left margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique geometric pattern formed by the cluster of four circular scars on the right lobe.
